items.content_html: Automatically generate technical documentation from source code using GPT-4. This project converts functions, classes, and modules into clean Markdown or PDF documentation using the OpenAI API. It integrates with tools like Sphinx and MkDocs without requiring a GPU, and is built with Python for easy automation and extensibility.
